items.title: Rural women deserve hand-holding for a brighter future, says Andhra Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan
items.summary: We need to salute their courage, resilience and enterprising nature, which are strengthening farms, sustaining families and driving villages forward, he says on the occasion of International Day of Rural Women
items.sum_en: We need to salute their courage, resilience and enterprising nature, which are strengthening farms, sustaining families and driving villages forward, he says on the occasion of International Day of Rural Women. Andhra Pradesh Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan urges investing in rural women's skills, finance, and leadership to empower them and strengthen villages.
items.sum_te: పొలాలను బలోపేతం చేయడం, కుటుంబాలను నిలబెట్టడం మరియు గ్రామాలను ముందుకు నడిపిస్తున్న వారి ధైర్యానికి, దృఢత్వానికి మరియు ఔత్సాహిక స్వభావానికి మనం సెల్యూట్ చేయాల్సిన అవసరం ఉందని అంతర్జాతీయ గ్రామీణ మహిళల దినోత్సవం సందర్భంగా ఆయన అన్నారు. ఆంధ్ర ప్రదేశ్ డిప్యూటీ సీఎం పవన్ కళ్యాణ్ గ్రామీణ మహిళల నైపుణ్యాలు, ఫైనాన్స్ మరియు నాయకత్వంలో పెట్టుబడులు పెట్టాలని వారిని సాధికారత మరియు గ్రామాలను బలోపేతం చేయాలని కోరారు.

items.title: GB win two golds at Track World Championships
items.summary: Great Britain claim gold in the women's team pursuit and the men's scratch race at the World Track Cycling Championships.
items.sum_en: GB win two golds at Track World Championships. Great Britain claim gold in the women's team pursuit and the men's scratch race at the World Track Cycling Championships.

From October 16 to November 5, medical examinations and necessary surgeries will be provided free of charge for eye, dental, ear and bone problems as well as many diseases.

items.sum_en: The railway department has given good news to the passengers. South Central Railway has decided to run several special trains keeping in mind the rush of passengers during the festival season of Dussehra and Diwali. To this extent, railway officials have announced that these special services will be available on Charlapally – Chennai Central, Charlapally – Nagercoil and Secunderabad – Visakhapatnam routes.

items.title: Globalisation cannot be reversed, but it must be navigated with greater resilience: Jaishankar
items.summary: Speaking at the forum in Abu Dhabi, EAM Jaishankar said that competition had intensified, new chokepoints have emerged, and the willingness to leverage advantages has grown
items.sum_en: Speaking at the forum in Abu Dhabi, EAM Jaishankar said that competition had intensified, new chokepoints have emerged, and the willingness to leverage advantages has grown. Jaishankar says globalisation can’t be reversed but must be navigated with resilience, highlighting IMEC and stronger partnerships amid rising competition.
items.sum_te: అబుదాబిలో జరిగిన ఫోరమ్‌లో EAM జైశంకర్ మాట్లాడుతూ, పోటీ తీవ్రమైందని, కొత్త చోక్‌పాయింట్‌లు ఉద్భవించాయని మరియు ప్రయోజనాలను ప్రభావితం చేసే సుముఖత పెరిగిందని అన్నారు. గ్లోబలైజేషన్‌ను తిప్పికొట్టడం సాధ్యం కాదని, పెరుగుతున్న పోటీ మధ్య IMEC మరియు బలమైన భాగస్వామ్యాలను హైలైట్ చేస్తూ, స్థితిస్థాపకతతో నావిగేట్ చేయాలని జైశంకర్ చెప్పారు.

items.title: ESA’s New Sentinel 3C Satellite Makes its Debut with Sumptuous Images of Italy and the Arctic
items.summary: Two weeks after launching, the European Space Agency’s Copernicus Sentinel 3C satellite has returned its first images of our world in sumptuous color. This first set of images includes stunning views of Italy, the…
items.sum_en: Two weeks after launching, the European Space Agency’s Copernicus Sentinel 3C satellite has returned its first images of our world in sumptuous color. The first image, captured by the ocean and land color instrument is a striking natural-color view that reveals Italy in beautiful detail.
items.sum_te: ప్రయోగించిన రెండు వారాల తర్వాత, యూరోపియన్ స్పేస్ ఏజెన్సీ యొక్క కోపర్నికస్ సెంటినెల్ 3C ఉపగ్రహం మన ప్రపంచం యొక్క మొదటి చిత్రాలను అద్భుతమైన రంగులో తిరిగి ఇచ్చింది. సముద్రం మరియు భూమి రంగు వాయిద్యం ద్వారా సంగ్రహించబడిన మొదటి చిత్రం, ఇటలీని అందమైన వివరంగా వెల్లడించే అద్భుతమైన సహజ-రంగు దృశ్యం.

items.title: PM Modi meets Asian Games medal winners; lauds strong performance
items.summary: Mr. Modi posed for pictures with the contingent that was accompanied by top officials of the sports bodies, including International Cricket Council Chairman Jay Shah
items.sum_en: Modi posed for pictures with the contingent that was accompanied by top officials of the sports bodies, including International Cricket Council Chairman Jay Shah. PM Modi honors India’s Asian Games medalists, praising record 85 medals and women’s key gold contributions, with tributes and memorabilia.
items.sum_te: అంతర్జాతీయ క్రికెట్ కౌన్సిల్ చైర్మన్ జే షాతో సహా క్రీడా సంస్థల ఉన్నతాధికారులతో కలిసి వచ్చిన బృందంతో మోదీ ఫొటోలు దిగారు. ప్రధాని మోదీ భారతదేశం యొక్క ఆసియా క్రీడల పతక విజేతలను సత్కరించారు, రికార్డు స్థాయిలో 85 పతకాలు మరియు మహిళల కీలక స్వర్ణ విరాళాలను ప్రశంసించారు, నివాళులు మరియు జ్ఞాపికలతో.

items.title: Pope's recovery on track after surgery, Vatican says
items.summary: Doctors reported good recovery in the operated lung two days after the pontiff underwent surgery to remove a cancerous tumour
items.sum_en: Doctors reported good recovery in the operated lung two days after the pontiff underwent surgery to remove a cancerous tumour. Vatican doctors say Pope Leo’s lung surgery recovery is progressing normally with independent daily activities and good X-ray results.
items.sum_te: క్యాన్సర్ కణితిని తొలగించడానికి పోప్‌ఫ్‌కు శస్త్రచికిత్స చేసిన రెండు రోజుల తర్వాత ఆపరేషన్ చేసిన ఊపిరితిత్తులు బాగా కోలుకున్నాయని వైద్యులు నివేదించారు. స్వతంత్ర రోజువారీ కార్యకలాపాలు మరియు మంచి ఎక్స్-రే ఫలితాలతో పోప్ లియో యొక్క ఊపిరితిత్తుల శస్త్రచికిత్స రికవరీ సాధారణంగా పురోగమిస్తోందని వాటికన్ వైద్యులు చెప్పారు.

items.title: Teen Triathlete Raises More Than $30,000 to Donate Bikes and Riding Lessons to Low-Income Families
items.summary: Continuing GNN’s coverage of youth nonprofit leaders, the Pedal Forward Foundation in Georgia has distributed hundreds of bicycles to low income families, and taught hundreds of children how to ride them. It’s founder,…
items.sum_en: Continuing GNN’s coverage of youth nonprofit leaders, the Pedal Forward Foundation in Georgia has distributed hundreds of bicycles to low income families, and taught hundreds of children how to ride them. It’s founder, Jonathan Thai, was inspired to step up and serve his community after the local REI closed down a community bike-riding workshop. At just 17 years old, the Alpharetta resident has already raised $30,000, securing 400 donated bicycles, and distributed 500 helmets.

items.sum_en: Local farmers voluntarily hand over 70 acres within its Full Tank Level area for restoration; HYDRAA is spending ₹35 crore on the project; the 112.80-acre wetland is a key habitat for migratory birds. items.title: This tiny jurassic predator helped pave the way for the human brain
items.summary: A 165-million-year-old fossil has revealed an extraordinary Jurassic predator that may help explain how mammals developed one of their most important evolutionary advantages. Although only 20 inches long, Megacauda…
items.sum_en: A 165-million-year-old fossil has revealed an extraordinary Jurassic predator that may help explain how mammals developed one of their most important evolutionary advantages. Although only 20 inches long, Megacauda sungei was a heavyweight among early mammal relatives, swimming through ancient waterways and hunting prey with specialized teeth. Its advanced swallowing anatomy reveals an early step toward the ability to safely nurse on milk, a key development in mammalian evolution.

items.title: Scientists make stunning discovery that could help explain why life exists
items.summary: Scientists have discovered that the universe's fundamental physical constants may be finely balanced to make life possible. Even tiny changes to these constants could make liquids too thick or too thin for essential…
items.sum_en: Scientists have discovered that the universe's fundamental physical constants may be finely balanced to make life possible. Even tiny changes to these constants could make liquids too thick or too thin for essential biological processes, potentially preventing life as we know it. Surprisingly, these life-friendly conditions existed billions of years before living cells appeared. The findings raise intriguing questions about why the laws of physics seem so well suited to life.
